title: BFF-ADM-007 current BFF administration through actual UI

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the Import Map grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Name" as "container-007"
5. And the baseline fixture data defines "Path" as "https://fixture.example/case-007.js"
6. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Edit" in the Import Map grid row with "Record Id" "101"
7. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" is visible on the Import Map administration page
8. When Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Name" with "container a" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
9. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Path" with "https://fixture.example/case-007.js" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
10. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Update" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
11. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" remains visible on the Import Map administration page
12. And the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar contains the exact text "You should not enter any space character on the Module Name or Path."
13. And the Import Map data grid with column "Record Id" row identifiers and loaded field values equal the initial grid snapshot on the Import Map administration page
